source: MongoDB edgeguard collections on live validation run 2026-10-18

methodology.detection_latency: Time from first stored telemetry sample for edge-001 in this run to incidents.detectedAt. Analyzer poll interval was 5s; values depend on heat ramp and window aggregation readiness.
methodology.detection_to_remediation: STAGED DEMO: response-worker was intentionally started ~140s after heat began so the Datadog demo monitor could reach ALERT before remediation. This interval is NOT autonomous closed-loop latency.
methodology.recovery_duration: remediation_actions.requestedAt → completedAt while observation window verified continuous healthy reported-safe telemetry (Remediation__ObservationSeconds=15).
methodology.before_metrics: Average of telemetry samples from 08:50:40Z through detectedAt (18 samples).
methodology.after_metrics: Average of first 20 safe-profile samples at/after resolvedAt through 08:53:40Z.
methodology.incident_evidence_snapshot: Stored on the incident document by the analyzer at open time (1m window averages).

caveats: All telemetry is synthetic (device simulator). Do not claim production fleet results.
detection_to_remediation_request includes intentional worker delay for Datadog ALERT visibility.
Monitor ALERT→OK observed on demo monitor (avg last_2m); production monitor uses last_5m.
